description: This Java source file defines the NotificationsActivity class, which handles user interactions to post notifications, either directly opening a content view or showing an interstitial message. It includes methods for creating and issuing notifications with specific content and intent configurations.

classes.name: NotificationsActivity
classes.description: Activity providing methods to generate and post notifications that either open a content viewer or display an interstitial message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to the notifications layout.

methods.name: onPostDirect
methods.description: Creates and posts a direct notification that opens ContentViewActivity with some extra text.

methods.name: onPostInterstitial
methods.description: Creates and posts an interstitial notification that opens InterstitialMessageActivity.
